title_en: Great Poems and Songs (2/20): Du Fu and "Spring View"
note_en: 被 marks the passive, and it appears all through this text: 杜甫也被困在城里 "Du Fu was also trapped in the city," 后来被称为《春望》 "was later called 'Spring View.'" Unlike English, Chinese doesn't need a "by" phrase or any change to the verb itself; 被 simply goes before the verb. 被称为 "be called" and 被视为 "be regarded as" are especially common in writing about history.
